about_the_game:
In the mid-10th century, during Japan’s Heian era, people of old imagined the celestial dwellers above as beings of noble grace and allure...

Listen to the "Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III" Soundtrack, and embark on a romantic yet uncanny voyage to the moon.

Track Introduction:

1. Celestial Beings

2. Traces of Firefly Light (Original：Ghostly Eyes)

3. Banquet of Insects (Original：Stirring an Autumn Moon ~ Mooned Insect)

4. Bloody River

5. Nightmare Reborn

6. Breaking Through the Bamboo Forest

7. Rabbit! Rabbit! (Original：White Flag of Usa Shrine)

8. History Will Not be Easily Forgotten  (Original: Nostalgic Blood of the East ~ Old World)

9. Time Waits for No One・A Thousand Years in a Day  (Original: Plain Asia / Extend Ash ~ Person of Hourai)

10. Shinra-Bansho   (Original: Cinderella Cage ~ Kagome-Kagome)

11. Mind Shooter (Original: Lunatic Eyes ~ Invisible Full Moon)

12. Return Journey  (Original: Voyage1969 / Voyage1970)

13. Courage of Humanity  (Original: Gensokyo Millennium ~ History of the Moon /
Flight of the Bamboo Cutter ~ Lunatic Princess)

14. Makuka Sai ～Eternal Night～  (Original: Reach for the Moon, Immortal Smoke)

15. Moritz's Game

16. Sink into The Darkness As It is

17. The Nightmare Arrival
